finding.title: The invalid input's color fails contrast on white
finding.explanation: An invalid input sets its text to `color.danger`, #ff6b6b, which is 2.8:1 on white. The error state becomes the hardest one to read.
finding.reasoningSummary: Computed the WCAG ratio of #ff6b6b on #ffffff: 2.78:1, under the 4.5:1 body-text minimum.
finding.suggestedFix: Use a darker danger token for text, for example #c62828 (5.6:1), and keep #ff6b6b for borders and icons.

evidence.text:
const color = invalid ? tokens.color.danger : tokens.color.text;
  return <input style={{ ...tokens.input, color, borderColor: color }} {...props} />;
